text:
joelle: hey hi everyone :wave: first day at Redwood! i’m Joelle — product designer, just moved here from portland. my desk is 3A-21 (near the big ficus). fun facts: i play the accordion badly and i bring an avocado to my lunch almost daily. happy to trade snack/plant tips.
sam: welcome joelle!! :tada: accordion + avocado combo = chef's kiss. coffee preference?
joelle: thanks sam! black coffee most days, decaf sometimes. also low-key obsessed with sticky notes.
mira: hi joelle — welcome! i’ll ping you about the intro pairing coffee later today. also FYI badge pickup is on the 2nd floor reception, security opens at 9:30.
joelle: perfect, thanks mira — did the badge email go out already or should i stop by IT?
mira: it went out this morning with the subject "Welcome to Redwood — badge pickup". if not, @ben can sort it.
ben: @joelle added you to the desk map and gave you a temporary wifi pass. if you need anything from IT (monitor arm, dongles) lmk. also there’s a spare avocado slicer in kitchen A. :avocado:
oliver: welcome!! i used to practice accordion in the stairwell until someone told me it echoed too much :grimacing: would love to hear you play sometime. rooftop lunch today 12:30?
joelle: rooftop lunch yes please — bringing half an avo for whoever wants it :avocado: will bring tiny accordion demo if people are into that.
kira: omg accordion demo mandatory. welcome joelle!! also quick poll: team plant care buddy? react with :seedling: if you want one, :x: if you hate plants.
joelle: reacting with :seedling: — i could use a low-light friend.
sam: :seedling: i have a pothos that needs a new best friend.
mira: also heads-up, onboarding doc link is here: https://intra.redwood/welcome/onboarding (DM me if access missing).
welcome-bot: Added joelle to #new-hires, #design, #watercooler and scheduled a 1:1 intro with their manager for Friday 10:00.
ben: small logistics: lunch card top-up machine by reception takes card only today FYI.
joelle: noted, will bring cash just in case. thanks everyone for the warm welcome :heart: super excited to be here!
oliver: yay! see you on the rooftop — we'll save you an avocado slice. :sun_with_face:
end
